title: Деревенский салат с тунцом  (Rustic Tuna Salad)

segments.t: Out in the kitchen, the new head chef Aleksandr gathers the cooks around the prep table to demonstrate a rustic salad with tuna, quail eggs, and olives. As he tears the lettuce leaves by hand, he entertains the crew with a tall tale about inventing the dish while stranded in a remote village.
